text:
That was where I fooled myself. I knew the meditations were helping them; I didn’t know how much was still unresolved. Someone can make huge progress from a terrible starting point and still be unstable in a relationship. Show me the last ugly conflict and I’ll learn more than I will from the best meditation you’ve ever had.

It’s easy to sound self-aware talking about old problems too. If everything bad is finished and every ex was the problem, I want to know what you’re still doing that you wish you weren’t.
